title: Power Book II Star Alix Lapri Calls Britney Spears Her GOAT
htmlContent:
Alix Lapri, best known for her role as Effie Morales in Power Book II: Ghost, made a name for Britney Spears as the GOAT (Greatest of All Time). In a candid moment, Lapri expressed her love for the legendary singer and enthusiastically gave her a shout-out in an interview with The Danza Project. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bIQd3_qW-Ds
"Shout out to Britney Spears, that's my GOAT right there. Protect Britney Spears at all costs. I love Britney Spears so much, dead ass," Lapri said with genuine excitement.
Britney Spears's declaration highlights her influence on Lapri as a performer and cultural icon. Lapri and many others acknowledge that Britney's influence is one of the most iconic figures in music history, even though they come from different industries. The pop star's admiration adds to the growing number of celebrities publicly supporting Spears in recent years. Britney Spears has been the focal point of public attention throughout her career. Her recent legal battles have resulted in an outpouring of love and protection from fans, fellow artists, and now even stars from the acting world like Lapri. Alix Lapri's portrayal of Effie in the Power universe seems influenced by Britney's influence. Lapri is not afraid to share her admiration for Britney's resilience or trailblazing career with the world. Alix Lapri remains a shining star on-screen while vocalizing the cultural figures who have influenced her. Lapri is inspired by powerful women who have made lasting impressions in their fields, as Britney Spears is her GOAT.
